title: Cambridge Professor Jason Arday’s Work Challenged Ahead of Book Launch
summary: A knife-wielding masked man. A pig’s head outside his parents’ door. Running 30 marathons in 35 days. The Cambridge professor Jason Arday, accused of plagiarism, says he’s been through it all. Not everyone believes him.
